integrity: Exact algebraic proof plus reproducible finite checks. Computations are not used to assert an infinite theorem. Known Bernstein spectral technique is acknowledged; related full-text access risk retained.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite graphs only; both part sizes must grow for the asymptotic. Fixed states are counted with threshold assignments; no basin, 2-cycle or transient-count claim.
title: An exact spectral census and square-root law for adaptive-threshold equilibria on complete bipartite graphs
